instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: Digital health platform for chronic disease management focusing on diabetes and hypertension. Combining connected glucometer and blood pressure monitor data with AI-driven care coaching and medication adherence reminders. 25,000 active patients managed through partnerships with 40 clinics. Evaluating predictive health deterioration alerts. We operate across multiple geographies and business units with a matrix organizational structure. A centralized digital transformation office coordinates innovation initiatives, but business unit autonomy means adoption varies significantly. Annual capex budget for innovation exists but deployment is gated by rigorous ROI modeling and steering committee approval.
answers.pastInitiatives: We launched a digital customer onboarding flow last quarter that reduced average onboarding time from 12 days to 5 days. The project was cross-functional involving product, compliance, and customer success teams. Early NPS scores for new customers onboarded through this flow are 22 points higher than the legacy process.
answers.strategicGoals: Customer retention has declined from 92% to 84% over the past 18 months, primarily among our mid-tier and enterprise segments. Exit interviews consistently cite product stagnation and poor digital self-service tools as reasons for leaving. We need to urgently modernize our customer-facing technology and proactively address the specific pain points driving churn before the trend becomes irreversible.
answers.teamSize: Innovation is decentralized across business units, each with its own innovation lead and dedicated resources, coordinated by a group-level Chief Innovation Officer. The total innovation workforce is approximately 100 people across the organization. A group innovation fund of €5M annually is allocated competitively — business units pitch for funding against clear innovation KPIs including revenue from new products and process efficiency gains.

input.changes_since_last: Major competitor entered our market. Customer churn rising. Need to accelerate digital transformation.

opportunities.title: Develop Proactive Self-Service Health Management Portal (Carry-Forward)
opportunities.rationale: The successful onboarding flow proves the capability to digitize processes and improve CX. To combat rising churn, this initiative must evolve from merely 'onboarding' to providing proactive, personalized health management tools accessible 24/7. This directly addresses customer feedback citing poor digital self-service.

first_actions: Map the patient journey post-onboarding, identifying high-risk intervention points (e.g., medication adherence gaps).
Develop user stories focused on predictive alerts and resource access outside of clinic hours.
Include compliance checkpoints for data aggregation and secure storage given the healthtech nature.
execution_plan.success_metric: Increase in monthly active self-service portal users by 15% within 6 months.
milestones: Low-fidelity prototype validated with clinical stakeholders (Month 1).
MVP launch focused on single, high-pain point (e.g., adherence reminder) (Month 3).

opportunities.title: Establish Centralized 'Voice of Customer' (VOC) to Strategy Linkage
opportunities.rationale: The entry of a major competitor and high churn signal that current strategic prioritization is reacting, not leading. The organization must break down silos by creating a mandatory loop where VOC data directly mandates funding review or product pivot decisions for all BUs. This tackles the core barriers in strategy and culture.

first_actions: Form an executive working group (C-level representation) tasked solely with prioritizing VOC insights against market threat intelligence.
Develop a standardized, quantitative scoring model for all incoming market feedback streams.
Pilot the process by integrating customer churn exit interview data directly into quarterly funding proposal reviews.
execution_plan.success_metric: Adoption of VOC insights as the mandatory first filter for 75% of annual innovation funding proposals.
milestones: Workshop designed and delivered to BUs on VOC methodology (Month 2).
Pilot cycle completed, resulting in one major strategic pivot decision based solely on this new framework (Month 4).

next_steps.action: Conduct rapid competitor landscape analysis to quantify the new threat and adjust risk modeling across all BUs.
Map end-to-end patient retention pathways to identify the specific process gaps (outside of onboarding) that correlate with churn in mid-tier segments.
Schedule a C-level alignment session dedicated to jointly funding the centralized VOC framework (opp_2) and securing commitment to break down siloed product roadmaps.

key_weaknesses: Strategic agility hampered by the centralized, ROI-gated funding committee structure.
Innovation efforts remain siloed within business units, failing to leverage shared cross-functional pain points (e.g., poor digital self-service).
Failure to formally quantify or integrate external competitive threat into internal strategic planning.

improvements: Successful launch of the digital customer onboarding flow, reducing time from 12 days to 5 days and increasing initial NPS scores by 22 points.
Demonstrated cross-functional coordination capability involving Product, Compliance, and Customer Success teams.
persistent_gaps: The structural barrier of the matrix organization still restricts rapid, coordinated action across all business units.
High level of institutional friction means that market urgency (competitor threat/churn) has not yet translated into mandatory budget reallocation or strategic mandate outside of the CDTO.
achieved_milestones: Quantifiable improvement in initial customer acquisition experience and satisfaction metrics.

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: Despite the entry of a major competitor and rising churn (increased market urgency), measurable internal progress was achieved in digitalizing initial customer onboarding processes, demonstrating capability but highlighting structural gaps.
